observations.why: The segment frames a test case as a reproduction of a production failure pattern — a structured A-is-to-B mapping (test ↔ prod) doing argumentative work, which is analogy's function.

observations.why: Two matched clauses with parallel modal-verb structure ('Must not X; must Y') — a performed parallelism, not an incidental pairing.
